## Changes

- Added management of independent panel layouts, including renaming layouts.
- Added a shared shortcut library.
- Expanded shared appearance controls for panel backgrounds, headers, and icons.
- Improved shortcut removal, configuration archives, management-window styling, and translations.
- Added a separate download-statistics helper to the repository.
